svg.title: saakshe — architecture
svg.text: ARCHITECTURE — THE AGENTIC COMPANY + ITS WITNESS
Google for Startups AI Agents Challenge · Track 1 BUILD
one founder · four realms · 42 agents · two human gates
two taps a day — owns both gates
the 43rd eye · never counted among the 42 · initiates nothing — the founder's taps land here
chat + voice (Gemini Live) · answers from tools, not vibes: anyone_waiting · cost_today · whats_reversible · what_learned · whos_acting
asked beyond its data, it refuses · every panel cites where it came from
watches one ordered event stream — every span, gate, action, cost
→ cited Context Pack v1→vN · 124-field schema · brand vault
INTELLECT · decides — the chamber every realm calls
→ ✦ prosecutor ⟲ @0.80 — revises only faulted reasons → GATE 1
COMMUNICATION · engages — the only mouth, authors nothing
plan — delivery schema has NO text field → assemble byte-for-byte
→ send gate (consent · caps) → GATE 2 → publish · dry-run default
IMAGINATION · makes — holds no channel keys, never ships
→ ✦ compliance fail-closed → verbatim handoff to kural
learns — outcome → new cited fact · pack ticks a version
cited to its source — or rejected
is the point, not a limitation

MODES — demo: deterministic, creds-free (judges & CI run the same day) · hybrid (prod today): every seat live, Claude seats on a Gemini understudy · live: Claude seated via Model Garden — one env flip
manas 10 · arivu 10 · kalai 11 · kural 11 = 42 agents — the witness is never counted · 2 human gates · ~500 tests run creds-free · built solo, net-new, during the contest
